# CodeExpo

CodeExpo is a high-performance multiplayer coding platform that integrates real-time document synchronization, live audio/video rooms, shared whiteboards, and developer feeds directly inside one unified tab.

## Public Pages
- Home: https://codeexpo.dev/
- Login: https://codeexpo.dev/login
- Register: https://codeexpo.dev/register

## Key Features
- **Multiplayer Editor**: Edit folders and code files collaboratively with automatic CRDT synchronization.
- **Video & Voice Rooms**: Connect with teams via voice/video calls and peer-to-peer screen sharing.
- **Developer Social Feed**: Post snapshots, compile code snippets securely inside isolated sandboxes, and follow other builders.
- **Shared Interactive Whiteboards**: Diagram ideas with direct peer updates on a joint canvas.
- **AI Pair Programming**: Integrated contextual hints and coding assistance.
